premise: Berry Bush wants to play hide-and-seek, but bushes can't move — so he hides his face deep in his own leaves; Glider and Parasaurolophus look by the lagoon and on the big flat rock, look right at him, and find him only when he can't help winking.
inspiration: The hider-who-can't-hide of folk humour, turned: the one who can't move hides best of all, until he gives himself away.
lesson: There is more than one way to join in.

en-US.title: Hide-and-Seek with Berry Bush
en-US.text: {bush:enter} {glider:enter} Glider and {parasaurolophus:enter} Parasaurolophus were playing hide-and-seek. {bush:face happy} "Can I play too?" asked Berry Bush. [gently] "But Bush," said Parasaurolophus, "you can't move!" Berry Bush only smiled. "You'll see." {parasaurolophus:pulse} Parasaurolophus closed her eyes and counted. One, two, three… {bush:live hide hold} {sfx:rustle} And Berry Bush tucked his face deep into his own leaves, until there was nothing to see but leaves and berries. "Ten! Ready or not!" {parasaurolophus:go to lagoon} Parasaurolophus looked by the lagoon. Not there. {glider:go to rocks} Glider glided over to the big flat rock {glider:live look-around hold} and looked this way and that. Not there either. [curious] Where could he be? They looked right at him. Just a bush. Just leaves and berries. Then one leaf moved. {bush:live hide resume} A little face peeked out, {bush:live wink} and winked! {glider:live look-around resume} {glider:face surprised} "THERE you are!" {parasaurolophus:go to bush} {glider:go to bush by scurry} {sfx:scurry} Back they ran, {parasaurolophus:face happy} {parasaurolophus:live laugh} laughing all the way. {all:face happy} Berry Bush hadn't moved a single leaf the whole game. [happily] He was the best hider in the valley, as long as he didn't wink.

es-ES.title: El escondite de Arbusto
es-ES.text: {bush:enter} {glider:enter} Planeador y {parasaurolophus:enter} Parasaurolophus jugaban al escondite. {bush:face happy} —¿Puedo jugar yo también? —preguntó Arbusto de bayas. [gently] —Pero, Arbusto —dijo Parasaurolophus—, ¡si tú no te puedes mover! Arbusto solo sonrió. —Ya veréis. {parasaurolophus:pulse} Parasaurolophus cerró los ojos y contó: uno, dos, tres… {bush:live hide hold} {sfx:rustle} Y Arbusto escondió la cara entre sus propias hojas, hasta que solo se veían hojas y bayas. —¡Diez! ¡Allá voy! {parasaurolophus:go to lagoon} Parasaurolophus buscó junto a la laguna. Allí no estaba. {glider:go to rocks} Planeador planeó hasta la gran roca plana {glider:live look-around hold} y miró a un lado y a otro. Allí tampoco. [curious] ¿Dónde se habría metido? Lo miraban y lo remiraban: un arbusto, nada más. Hojas y bayas. Hasta que una hoja se movió. {bush:live hide resume} Asomó una carita {bush:live wink} ¡y les guiñó un ojo! {glider:live look-around resume} {glider:face surprised} —¡AHÍ ESTÁS! {parasaurolophus:go to bush} {glider:go to bush by scurry} {sfx:scurry} Volvieron corriendo, {parasaurolophus:face happy} {parasaurolophus:live laugh} riéndose a carcajadas. {all:face happy} Arbusto no había movido ni una hoja en todo el juego. [happily] Era el que mejor se escondía de todo el valle, siempre que no guiñara el ojo.

rustle.prompt: a small leafy bush rustling softly as something tucks into its leaves, realistic, close
